title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Pit Jacket. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Pit Jacket
options.lineage: Chicago open-outcry pits: loud firm jackets, block-caps trader badges, buy/sell trading cards
options.thesis: Every pair wears a trader's badge, and every signal is a card thrown into the pit.
options.viewport: Top bar on warm pit-floor black with a gold jacket stripe; MA-cross alerts as dealt cards; matrix and watchlist rows lead with black-and-white badge symbols.
options.risk: The badge move can get loud if more than symbols wear it.

raised.raise: One tuned warm-neutral ramp carries all chrome; gold appears only on selection and primary action.
Superseded signals never vanish: they stay in place, struck through and timestamped.
Rank is carried by weight and case on a four-step type scale, not by big headings.
Every panel snaps to one 12-column, 8px armature with shared edges across sections.
Small multiples (matrix cells, yield charts) share one scale and baseline so they compare honestly.

options.label: Banknote
options.lineage: Security-printed banknotes: intaglio, guilloche, one ink per currency
options.thesis: Each currency keeps its banknote ink, so every pair reads as two notes side by side.
options.viewport: Pale security-paper ground, ink-green header; pairs drawn as two-ink split chips; matrix cells tinted by both currencies.
options.risk: The USD green fights bull green, so direction must move to arrows and weight.

options.label: Split-Flap Board
options.lineage: Solari departure boards, the same boards old exchanges posted quotes on
options.thesis: The watchlist is a departure board: rows hold still, only the changed cells flip.
options.viewport: Matte black board; the watchlist as fixed columns in condensed caps; a freshly crossed pair lights its amber lamp and flips its signal cell.
options.case: Wins clarity (change cascades are glanceable state) but the badge world is closer to the trader's own history.
options.risk: Condensed caps everywhere can tire the eye over a full session.

options.label: Monochrome Product Marketing
options.thesis: One neutral scale, one rare accent.
options.case: A Persuade form; on a working screen it collapses into the category default.
options.kept: Neutral-ramp discipline: accent only for action and selection.

options.label: Jet-Age Ticket Wallet
options.case: Traders do not identify with travel paperwork.
options.kept: Superseded states stay visible, struck and stamped.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.lineage: pocket timetables on a light table
options.thesis: One type size; rank by weight and case.
options.case: Raked containers hurt scanning on a dense working screen.
options.kept: Rank by weight and case, a tight type scale.

options.label: Crouwel Grid Specimen
options.thesis: The grid is visible and binding.
options.case: A poster form; monumental type has no place in a dense tool.
options.kept: One binding armature, shared edges everywhere.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: Same scale, same ground, honest comparison.
options.kept: Small multiples share one scale and baseline.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The dark charting-terminal look every trading app ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Navy top bar, blue accent tabs, panels of tables and charts.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every charting tool by design.
